svg.title: Farming axis positions
svg.desc: Six low views across farmland, one per position on the farming axis, each at the scale its kind of array is usually built at and each set above a strip of foreground, with the sky in each tinted from blue at the sharing end to purple at the sparing end. S0 Created agriculture, about 190 meters across: panels on a capped landfill at the edge of town, grazed by sheep, with a stormwater pond in front and warehouses, a water tower, and the town beyond. S1 Primary agriculture, about 40 meters across: up close, sheep grazing the pasture in front of, between, and under the rows, with a stock tank and a fence. S2 Secondary agriculture, about 100 meters across: a former corn field cut for hay, round bales in the aisles, and beehives along a flowering edge by the farm lane. S3 Ordinary-land siting, about 520 meters across: a whole forty at the crossroads taken and mown, the distribution line along the road, a creek and the farm beyond. S4 Low-productivity siting, about 860 meters across: arrays in the four dry corners of a center pivot whose circle is still farmed, among the neighbors' pivots, with an irrigation pond. S5 Impaired-land siting, about 330 meters across: panels following a prairie strip along the creek the field used to wash into, with corn still farmed in front.
svg.text: a use that was not there
